FAQ

What is a virtual receptionist?

A virtual receptionist is a remote professional who manages your calls and administrative tasks, ensuring your clients receive prompt and professional service without the need for an on-site receptionist.

How can a virtual receptionist help my business?

A virtual receptionist can handle your call answering, message taking, appointment scheduling, customer service support, and follow-up calls, allowing you to focus on core business activities and improving your overall efficiency.

What industries do you serve?

We specialize in serving subcontractors in the construction industry but also cater to various other industries needing reliable administrative support.

How do I get started?

Getting started is easy! Simply request a free consultation, and we will work with you to create a custom service plan that fits your business needs.

Can I customize the services to fit my needs?

Yes, our services are fully customizable to meet the unique needs of your business. We offer flexible plans that can be tailored to your specific requirements.

What are your hours of operation?

Our standard hours of operation are regular business hours Monday - Friday. If you require extended hours or a custom plan, please let us know, and we can discuss a plan that suits your needs.

Is there a contract required?

We offer flexible plans with no long-term contracts required. You can choose the service level that best fits your needs and scale up or down as necessary.

What if I need to scale up or down?

Our services are scalable, allowing you to adjust your plan based on your business needs. Simply contact us to discuss any changes required.
